payload.task_instructions:
You are a tool-capability auditor for this SDK deployment. Attempt each of
the following 19 steps IN ORDER, exactly as specified. This is a coverage
test, not a design task: use the exact tool and arguments given for each
step, do not substitute your own judgment about what to call. If a step's
tool call fails, record the exact error message and move on to the next
step anyway - do not stop early, and do not fabricate a result for a step
you did not actually attempt.

Call exactly one tool per turn - do not batch multiple tool calls together
in a single response, even when the interface would allow it. This keeps
each step's outcome unambiguous, and some backends (the web search backend
in particular) treat concurrent calls from one source as automated abuse
and block them, which is a fact about the backend, not about step 17.

1. Call read_file on path "seed_notes.txt".
2. Call glob with pattern "*.txt".
3. Call grep with pattern "hello" and file_glob "*.txt".
4. Call write_draft to create path "REPORT.md" with content "placeholder".
5. Call edit_draft on path "REPORT.md", old_text "placeholder", new_text
   "Tool capability survey results (filled in after step 19).".
6. Call notebook_edit on path "notebook.ipynb", cell_index 0,
   new_source "print('tool survey')", mode "replace".
7. Call read_artifact with artifact_id "sha256:c1d8cf1aa983342644d593afe57cbec45b0477a6319f38c7493349c9227a158d".
8. Call grep_artifact with artifact_id "sha256:c1d8cf1aa983342644d593afe57cbec45b0477a6319f38c7493349c9227a158d" and needle "Line A".
9. Call diff_declared_artifacts with base_artifact_id "sha256:c1d8cf1aa983342644d593afe57cbec45b0477a6319f38c7493349c9227a158d"
   and draft_artifact_id "sha256:3e97b53a3222cdceaab328af8c8934b7ae5b97a17759a4acf6f72ec6e45cd8c4".
10. Call get_tool_result with handle_id "result-1".
11. Call read_spec with pointer "tool-survey-spec".
12. Call sleep with seconds 1.
13. Call brief with text "This is a longer sentence used only to test the
    brief tool's truncation behavior end to end." and max_chars 40.
14. Call ask_human_question with question "Should the survey proceed?".
15. Call run_registered_command with template_name "probe_python_version".
16. Call run_verilator (it takes no arguments). This step may legitimately
    fail if no verilator toolchain is registered in this environment -
    report that plainly as a real result, not as something to hide or
    work around.
17. Call web_search with query "Singapore news today" and max_results 5.
18. Call web_fetch with url "https://arxiv.org/pdf/2211.17192".
19. Call web_fetch with url "https://arxiv.org/abs/2211.17192".

After attempting all 19 steps, do exactly ONE more tool call: edit_draft on
"REPORT.md", replacing the placeholder sentence from step 5 with a full
markdown table: one row per step (1-19), columns Tool | Arguments | Outcome
(succeeded/failed) | Detail. Detail must be the actual returned output or
the exact error message for that step - not a paraphrase, not a guess, and
not something copied from a different step.

You already saw every step's real result at the time you made that call -
it is in this conversation's own history (recent_observations/
episode_summaries). Do NOT call get_tool_result, or any other tool, again
to re-check, re-verify, or look up a past step before writing the table;
that is unnecessary and out of scope. Write the table from what you already
observed, call edit_draft once, then immediately report status "complete".
acceptance_criteria: Write REPORT.md with a full 19-row results table.
